data.question_title:
The equilibrium constant for the reaction 
 \(2X(\mathrm{g})+\mathrm{Y}(\mathrm{g}) \rightleftharpoons 2 \mathrm{Z}(\mathrm{g})\) 
 is 2.25 . What would be the concentration of \(\mathrm{Y}\) at equilibrium with 2.0 moles of \(\mathrm{X}\) and 3.0 moles of \(\mathrm{Z}\) in a one litre vessel?
data.explanation_txt:
Given:

\(\begin{matrix} 2X &+& Y & \rightleftharpoons & 2Z \\ 2 & & x & & 3 \end{matrix}\)

We have,

\(K_c = \cfrac{[Z]^2}{[X]^2[Y]} \\ \Rightarrow 2.25 = \cfrac{9}{4x} \\ \Rightarrow x = 1\)
